entities.title: Swarmhold
entities.summary: An original single-player rescue game made in Godot 4 for the web: get into a walled desert city overrun by giant ants, find the hostage and lead them out through a gate before time runs out.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot client in godot/, the page's static files in web/, the Cloudflare Worker in worker/ and its tests in test/. It is one npm project, built by build.mjs and deployed as one Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/ and the login service, neither edited here.
Single player: the game runs entirely in the browser. The Worker has no API and no database, so there is no high-score table.

Not a remake: it is in the genre of early-1980s isometric city-rescue games but copies no game's text, art, maps or code, so the clean-room skills do not apply. Its only third-party file is the Montserrat font (SIL OFL).
